persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: That's me in the park photo. Put my face on the astronaut in the poster, please. Keep the suit, stars and retro look, and don't add any text.
bank.Target: The astronaut's visible face in poster-astronaut.jpg.
bank.Style and preservation: Keep the original retro poster style, suit, helmet and star background.
bank.Size and platform: Keep the vertical 9:16 poster shape; free-tier size is fine.

messages.text: That’s me in the park photo I’ve attached, and I’d like you to put my face on the astronaut in the attached poster. I thought this would be a fun way to imagine myself in one of those old space posters. What I mean is to replace the astronaut’s visible face with mine from the park pic, keeping the vertical 9:16 poster shape, and a free-tier size is fine. Please keep the original suit, helmet, stars in the background and retro poster look. I’m a little worried about losing the charm of the original poster in the process. Please don’t add any text.
